scope: Production build, loopback server, disposable UTF8 database. Outbound email disabled. No actual owner content was published and no new public pages were added.
checks: Origin, content type, token, malformed/oversized body, unknown fields, honeypot and field validation reject without saving
Concurrent retries create one durable inquiry; conflicting reuse returns 409; both finalized form sources save their existing fields
Disabled email produces visible retryable notification failure after acceptance; private inquiry/status APIs deny visitors; owner workflow cannot falsify delivery or edit original input
Storage failures never return acceptance; form message/contact details and provider secrets are absent from public HTML
Published owner form labels/help/next-step copy refresh on existing homepage and Contact routes without creating new pages
